adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253 in the diff, the code is: `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. This is inside a ternary where the condition is `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : ...`. So when externalCalendarId is truthy, it uses externalCalendarId directly. When externalCalendarId is falsy (null/undefined), it tries to find a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` - but externalCalendarId is falsy at this point, so it's comparing against null/undefined, which will never match any valid calendar externalId. This means the fallback logic is broken and will always return undefined when externalCalendarId is not provided. The same bug appears at line 315 for deleteEvent.
